name: Zhong Ju Investment Group Limited
summary: Zhong Ju Investment Group Limited operates as an integrated auto service provider in the People's Republic of China. The company sells new and used motor vehicles, as well as accessories, spare parts, new energy vehicles, and charging equipment; and provides after-sales, car care services, used vehicle warranty, repair and maintenance, inspection, insurance agency, and other services. It also provides vehicle licensing registration services and registration of title transfer of used vehicles; vehicle mobility services; enterprise management information and information consulting services; and enterprise investment consultancy services related to the sale of used vehicles.
